title: Supportive housing - Province of British Columbia
body: Supportive housing provides long-term housing and on-site supports for people experiencing, or at risk of, homelessness. It is operated by government organizations, such as BC Housing or health authorities, or by non-profit organizations. The operator also provides on-site support to tenants.

body: The Supportive Housing Program Framework encompasses both new and existing housing programs that provide funding for subsidized housing with support services to people who are experiencing homelessness or at risk of homelessness.

title: Tenant Insurance - BC Non-Profit Housing Association | BCNPHA
body: As an affordable housing operator, your day is full of challenges — chasing tenants for proof of insurance shouldn't be one of them. That's why BC Non-Profit Housing Association and Community Housing Coverage have partnered with HUB International to offer a digital tenant insurance solution designed specifically for their members.
